# RaS Techno (Rakesh and Siddharth Techno Pvt Ltd)

> Innovation Meets Creativity. We blend artistry with technology — Animation, Software Development, AI & Automation, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

RaS Techno is an India-based creative technology studio specialising in:
- AI & Automation (LLM integrations, Agentic workflows, RAG systems)
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — optimising brands for ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and other AI answer engines
- SEO to GEO migration services
- SaaS to GaaS (Generative-AI-as-a-Service) transformation
- Software Development (Web, Mobile, SaaS platforms)
- 3D Animation & Motion Graphics
- IT Solutions & Consultancy
